Can you confirm:

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the details and the draft list. The rooftop is available on Oct 14; we can do 6–10 pm with an optional 30-minute setup window earlier. A few notes so you can budget:
- Venue fee: $4,500 flat for evenings (covers staffing & basic security)
- Minimum F&B spend: $3,000 (we can share sample menus)
- AV/staging: Aurora can provide a small PA + projector for $750; staging over 2m x 2m will be an additional charge

We do require guest clearance for any executives flagged as "sensitive"; we run names through building security and issue temporary badges. We need final list 72 hours prior to event (cutoff Oct 11).

I've attached our standard terms for rooftop events: Aurora_Rooftop_Terms_v1.pdf. We're happy to accept DocuSign and can add Redwood as a co-sponsor section. I'll loop Kevin from operations for insurance questions.

DocuSign link (pre-fill coming once you confirm insurers): https://app.docusign.com/rooms/aurora-rooftop-contract-6892
